walk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art tactical map walking sprites for STONE WING BEAST.
Image1 = established character design: a wholly NONHUMAN QUADRUPED stone gargoyle-drake, small angular horned head with hooked jaw, four hooked taloned legs, long tapering stone tail, broad carved rock plates, TWO batlike stone wings. Preserve this exact species and face. Image2 = color/material reference ONLY: copy the enemy swordmaster's gentle restrained BLUE-PURPLE color family, medium value readability, pale stone planes and navy contours. Never insert a human. Image3 = original Gaiden tactical movement phase guide, authoritative for the raised/spread wing sequence and direction. Retarget wing/body anatomy to the quadruped model.

Deliver SIX COMPLETE figures in a strict THREE COLUMNS x TWO ROWS grid, transparent background, generous independent cell padding, no labels, grids or scene. Columns: BACK view moving up / RIGHT-facing side view moving right / FRONT view moving down. Top row phase0: wings spread outward/downward in the original open-wing phase. Bottom row phase1: wings raised upward and slightly tucked in, original upstroke phase. Same head, chest/spine, pelvis coordinates, body scale and claw height in both phases of each direction. Changing wing silhouette must NEVER move the whole body or change scale. Local elbows/wing joints and little talon/toe movements only; no bobbing. Four legs remain organically connected to chest and pelvis; show nearer legs in front of the far legs. Flying posture: bent hind legs tucked under body, foreclaws slightly forward, body held level. Side view entire tail remains visible; front/back quadruped silhouette may be foreshortened with two pairs of claws, never become a humanoid.

Body palette: about TEN to TWELVE intentional colors; muted periwinkle/slate BLUE-PURPLE stone midtones, soft pale blue-grey plane faces, deeper indigo on wing membranes and far limbs, dark navy outline. Keep stone LIGHT enough to be readable, not muddy dark grey. Tiny muted amber eyes only. Matte flat stone planes with necessary form shadow; remove gold veins, shine, glossy speckles and noisy texture. No hair, clothes, weapons, equipment, crystals, aura, glow or magic. Crisp coherent clean pixel clusters readable at 24-pixel logical height / 4x detail. Every wing tip, horn, tail and toe must fit fully inside its cell. No floor or cast shadow.
idle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: THREE tactical-map IDLE poses of the SAME NONHUMAN quadruped blue-purple stone wing beast in image1. Preserve the exact small horned drake head, hooked jaw, segmented rock back, four taloned legs, TWO stone bat wings, tapering tail and muted amber eyes. Image2 shows the ORIGINAL idle phases 0,1,2; copy its wing spread → half tuck → narrow fold sequence while adapting to the four-legged body.
Produce THREE COMPLETE creatures arranged ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, all viewed FRONT with slight three-quarter depth, same scale, head/chest/hip position and same four planted claw positions in every pose. Forelegs in front, hindlegs darker and partly visible behind. Head remains fixed at the same height; wings hinge at shoulder joints while chest, head and pelvis stay centered. Tail visible curling behind but not hiding claws.
Left: wings open outward to a medium wide span, alert grounded crouch.
Middle: wings half tucked, moving inward toward shoulders.
Right: wings held more narrowly/upward beside body; same body and feet as before.
Strict TRUE transparent background: only creature pixels, no fog, halo, gradient backdrop, drop shadow or floor. Generous margin for wing tips, tail and claws in each independent cell. Same restrained periwinkle/slate BLUE-PURPLE matte stone palette as image1, pale blue-grey rock planes, dark navy contours, indigo wing membranes, about 10-12 purposeful tones. No gold cracks, gloss, shine, sparkles, aura, clothing, hair, weapons or equipment. Crisp clean tactical RPG pixel art, readable small, full coherent anatomy, no extra legs or wings. No labels or grids.
battle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: six complete battle poses of the SAME stone wing beast.
Reference1 fixes anatomy: NONHUMAN quadrupedal gargoyle-drake, four hooked taloned legs, small angular horned rock head and pointed jaw, long tapering tail, stone back plates and TWO batlike stone wings. Reference2 fixes the NEW approved production color/material direction: gentle LIGHT blue-purple stone, muted indigo wings and dark navy outline, tiny soft amber eyes. Match that model closely, four legs rather than humanoid arms and legs. Reference3 is the original Gaiden battle pose guide; preserve the PURPOSE and wing sequence, adapted to the established quadruped anatomy.

Output SIX separate COMPLETE full-body sprites, THREE COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, all facing RIGHT, same creature physical scale. Strict transparent background with NO haze, glow, aura, cast shadow or floor. At least 12% transparent padding inside every cell; fully include tails, horns, wings and toes. No labels or grids.
Top-left pose9: neutral guarded crouch, wings partly folded, four feet braced, alert jaw closed.
Top-middle pose10: airborne mid wingbeat, wings obliquely raised to a medium angle, rear talons tucked and foreclaws hanging forward; head/chest/body center held at the same position as the next flight phases.
Top-right pose11: airborne high upstroke, TWO wings raised above back, far wing visible behind near wing, body/neck position and scale SAME as pose10, legs tucked.
Bottom-left pose12: airborne downstroke, wings extend wide and down/outward; same head/chest/hips as flight10/11, no whole-body bob or shrink.
Bottom-middle pose14: a compact attack windup, body/neck pulled low and back, wings fold in preparing a short sharp dive, near foreclaw flexed behind ready to extend. This is preparation, no damage/effects.
Bottom-right pose13: a single decisive forward dive CLAW CONTACT and finish: chest thrust low/forward, near foreleg fully extends forward with open hooked talons, far foreleg a little behind; hind legs trail tucked, wings partially sweep back. One claw attack, no bite beam. Strong connected shoulder-elbow-wrist anatomy, far limbs darker and BEHIND nearer limbs.

Flat matte stone planes, approximately 10-12 intentional shades total, muted periwinkle/slate blue-purple midtones with pale blue-grey faces, navy/indigo shadows. Avoid dirty dark grey, golden veins, mottled noisy texture, specular highlights or magical brightness. Crisp clean RPG pixel clusters, readable full creature at game size. No human features, clothing, weapons, tridents, swords or shields. Do not create new creatures or extra limbs.
extra:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: four additional BATTLE poses of the EXACT same blue-purple quadruped stone gargoyle-drake in the reference sheet. Preserve face, horn/jaw shape, four taloned legs, long stone tail, segmented rock plates, two stone bat wings, body size and soft amber eyes. Same crisp restrained pale blue-purple/indigo matte stone style, about 10-12 tones, navy outline, no gold cracks or gloss.

FOUR COMPLETE independent full-body figures, TWO COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, all facing RIGHT, identical physical model scale and planted claw floor.
Top-left: ROCK SPIT PREPARATION. Four legs brace on ground, neck retracts and head lifts slightly, jaws just part, wings low/folded. Small stone mass forming inside the throat but no glow, no magic.
Top-right: ROCK SPIT RELEASE. Same body/foot positions, neck extends slightly forward, jaws open wider and a single small angular GREY-BLUE ROCK CORE visible between the jaws about to leave. No rock outside mouth, no flame/beam or breath. This is one physical projectile.
Bottom-left: HURT RECOIL. Head recoils back, near foreleg bends and stone wings pull protectively inward. Small clear flinch, no wounds/gore; keep torso/feet grounded.
Bottom-right: THICK STONE ARMOR / DEFENSIVE REST. Same creature turns slightly so a broad folded wing and thick shoulder stone plates face viewer; face still visible looking right, all four claws anchored, no shield or equipment.

Four legs belong to shoulders/hips, far legs darker and behind near legs; no humanoid arms/hands. Wings attached separately above shoulder plates. Full wing tips, tail, horns and toes fully inside each cell with at least 10% transparent margins. ONLY creature pixels on true transparent background, no fog, halo, drop shadow, floor, text, frame, glow or outside particle effects.
effects:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art FX sprite strip for a physical STONE CLAW / ROCK SPIT impact, matching the attached blue-purple matte stone beast.
FOUR separated elements in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, generous transparent margins and equal cells. Pure transparent background, no creature, no text/grid, no glow/halo.
Cell1: ONE compact angular blue-grey stone core, an irregular faceted fist-sized pebble with dark navy outline, 3-4 clear slate/pale-lavender stone facets. No smoke or trail.
Cell2: FIRST IMPACT a tight jagged pale blue-grey star-like fracture at center and 5 small angular indigo/lavender rock chips bursting outward. Powerful but physical, no magical lightning/flame.
Cell3: expanded burst with 7-9 small faceted chips around a broken core, short pale dust puffs, wider than cell2 but only modest sparse pixels.
Cell4: fading aftermath: a few small blue-purple chips and very light sparse stone dust flecks falling, center mostly transparent.
Crisp clean deliberately pixelated RPG sprite effects, only 6-8 flat tones: dark navy, slate indigo, muted lavender-grey, pale blue-grey. Restrained saturation, no bright white flash or luminous gradients, no yellow/orange. Each complete burst inside its own cell, no touching outer edge, no floor shadow, no background color. Each effect readable when reduced to 16-24 logical pixels.
appearance: Established quadruped stone drake; new restrained blue-purple palette referenced to enemy swordmaster.
